text:
nina_research: Hey team — took the Eurostar back from London and my corporate card declined at the ticket kiosk. I used my personal card and the machine produced a card-only receipt (no merchant VAT info). Later I see a second charge on the corpcard for the same route (looks like a duplicate). Can I get reimbursed for the personal charge and also get the duplicate charge fixed?

anna_finance: Hi Nina — sorry about the hassle. Two parts: (1) reimburse your personal payment, (2) investigate the duplicate corpcard charge. For reimbursement we need the personal receipt + short note explaining corpcard fail. For the duplicate charge we need the corpcard statement line and the kiosk receipt.

nina_research: Uploaded files: eurostar_personal_1023.jpg, corpcard_statement_1023.pdf. The amounts are €89.50 (personal) and €89.50 (corpcard). Machine printed a code but no VAT.

sam_ops: Quick check  our cards sometimes soft-decline and the terminal retries which can cause a preauth then final charge. Payments team can reverse the duplicate if it's an authorisation hold that cleared twice. @payments-bot can you take a look?

payments-bot: Received request. Please confirm: charged_date=2026-07-10; corpcard_last4=4321; amount=EUR 89.50; request_id=PR-4472. I'll open a dispute with the acquiring bank if the merchant can't reverse. Typical resolution 3-10 business days.

reimburse-bot: To submit reimbursement use the template below in the expense notes and attach receipts: 
``
expense_type: train_personal_payment
date: 2026-07-10
amount_claimed: EUR 89.50
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: eurostar_personal_1023.jpg, corpcard_statement_1023.pdf
notes: corporate card failed at kiosk resulting in personal payment; duplicate corpcard charge under investigation (PR-4472)
```

anna_finance: Once you submit I'll route the reimbursement. For the duplicate corpcard charge, if payments-bot gets a reversal we'll clear the corpcard line. If bank only issues a refund to the merchant, it'll show as a credit on next statement; we'll track and reconcile.

nina_research: Submitted as expense ID 113211. Thanks — please keep me posted on the duplicate charge, it's showing as "pending" on the corpcard.

payments-bot: Dispute opened (case DC-551). Noted Nina's expense ID 113211 for parallel reimbursement. Will update thread when bank responds.

anna_finance: A reminder: if the duplicate charge remains and the bank can't reverse quickly, we'll temporarily reimburse you and then reconcile once the credit posts. Will notify you before issuing a temporary payment.

sam_ops: Thanks all — tagging finance and payments for visibility. Nina, ping here if the corpcard pending charge turns into a posted charge (not pending).
